base.reason: contains the only NHL system (serving builder, gates, forward snapshot collector PR #49/#53); no NHL PR open

forbidden_to_touch: existing NHL gate/baseline scripts and model artifacts
scientific_standard: Model must independently predict what happens on the ice. Chain: AVAILABILITY/LINEUP -> TEAM GAME ENVIRONMENT -> ICE TIME/LINE/PP ROLE -> OPPORTUNITY -> EFFICIENCY -> CENTRAL STAT PROJECTION -> (later) UNCERTAINTY. A feature needs mechanism, causal layer, pregame availability and out-of-time value. No credit for math sophistication.

sportsbook_firewall.rule: No sportsbook line, odds, implied probability, over/under line value, bookmaker or market consensus may be an input, target, selector, eligibility filter or tuning signal of any V2 science code.
sportsbook_firewall.note_on_fixed_thresholds: The current system uses fixed round-number thresholds (SOG 2.5, points 0.5, saves 24.5) as CLASSIFICATION TARGETS, not as live book lines. Phase0 audits them as 'current-model target thresholds'. V2 science does not use them as inputs.
sportsbook_firewall.enforced_by: tests/test_nhl_v2_phase0.py AST/text scan of nhl_v2_*.py science modules

monte_carlo: NOT BUILT, NOT TUNED. Baseline distributional conversion uses closed-form Poisson tail only (analytic, no sampling).

goalie_saves.current: XGBoost P(saves>=25) - built, gate FAILED, not served

team_moneyline.current: XGBoost+Platt P(home win) in-season; prior-season bootstrap early

central_projection_rule: The current NHL system emits only threshold probabilities, never a central stat projection. Phase0 therefore grades the model's OWN output (its probability) and records CENTRAL_PROJECTION_ABSENT. No central-projection MAE is fabricated for the current model. Simple and human baselines emit central projections (MAE/bias/within-k reported) and are converted to threshold probabilities by closed-form Poisson tail for probability comparison.

FIT.note: 2020 (Jan-May 2021) is a shortened COVID-schedule season; kept, flagged. Baseline constants/priors may be estimated here only.

SELECTION.note: only place any baseline shrinkage constant may be chosen, from a preregistered grid, once

BURNED_DIAGNOSTIC.note: consumed by the existing champion gates; reported as diagnostic, never as validation

UNTOUCHED_VALIDATION.note: no existing NHL gate/baseline script references 2025 as fit/selection/holdout (verified by grep); evaluated ONCE, frozen

CLEAN_FORWARD.source: Phase0C forward snapshot capture only; NOT evaluated in Phase0

chronology.rule: once locked, no alteration; no re-slicing after results

population.RAW: every skater_games / goalie_games row in the season
population.MEANINGFUL_skater: pregame-only: >=5 prior games this season (same-season, strictly earlier game_date) AND mean TOI over prior 3 games >= 480 s. No use of target-game TOI, scratch status or result. Mirrors current-model eligibility so the comparison is like-for-like.
population.MEANINGFUL_goalie: pregame-only: >=3 prior goalie appearances this season with prior-3 mean TOI >= 1800 s. The current builder's SAVES_MIN_TOI_SECONDS filter must be audited for use of target-game TOI (postgame selection); if present it is reported as a defect.
population.headline: MEANINGFUL on UNTOUCHED_VALIDATION

ledgers.CLEAN: may censor ONLY preregistered abnormal exits detectable from stored data: skater toi_seconds < 0.5 * own prior-3 mean TOI with no stored reason cannot be proven as injury, so CLEAN in Phase0 censors none unless an explicit exit flag exists in the data; absence of such flag is reported as CLEAN==RAW (BLOCKED_DATA for exit labels). Never censor poor play, benching, goalie pull, blowouts, empty-net.

metrics.uncertainty: paired game-block (game_date) bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 20261007, 95% CI on metric differences vs baseline

goals: prior_sog_expectation_x_regressed_shooting_pct, k=100 shots prior toward FIT-period league rate
saves: opp_prior_sog_for_per_game x goalie_prior_share x regressed_save_pct (k=400 shots)
simple.rule: not over-optimized; constants fixed here; a single pass

competent_human.sog: expected_TOI(prior3 mean TOI) /3600 * prior_sog_per60(shrunk 20 games toward position-league rate) * opponent_factor(opp prior shots-allowed per game / league mean, damped 0.5)  [no PP adjustment available historically: PP TOI not stored -> stated limitation]
competent_human.points: same opportunity chain with points per60, same damping
competent_human.saves: ONLY computable conditional on prior starter pattern: expected opp SOG (prior shots-for per game, damped 0.5) x goalie regressed save pct; historical confirmed-starter state unavailable -> conditional-on-actual-start diagnostic labeled non-headline

status_rules.CURRENT_MODEL_SURVIVES_BASELINE_AUDIT: Brier(current) lower than every simple baseline AND the human baseline with paired-bootstrap 95% CI upper bound of difference < 0 vs the best of them, AND ECE <= 0.03
status_rules.CURRENT_MODEL_WEAK: not worse than best baseline with CI excluding zero, but does not meet SURVIVES
status_rules.CURRENT_MODEL_REJECTED: worse than best simple baseline with CI excluding zero, or ECE > 0.05 on untouched validation
status_rules.BLOCKED_DATA: stat or comparator cannot be computed from stored data
status_rules.BLOCKED_TIMING: required pregame state (confirmed goalie starter, scratches, lines, PP units) has no historical timestamped capture; market claim depending on it cannot be validated historically
status_rules.no_promotion: Phase0 promotes nothing. One market's status never lends credibility to another.

source_rules: No systematic scraping of sources whose terms prohibit it; Phase0 makes no new network retrieval of provider data; audit is of repo code, stored data and the already-committed forward-capture contract.

catastrophic_miss.sog: |actual-projection|>3 for baselines/human; for current model: probability <0.15 and actual>=6 (or >0.85 and actual<=0)
catastrophic_miss.cause_attribution: evidence-based only from stored fields; otherwise UNATTRIBUTED

ordering: This file is committed before nhl_v2_phase0_audit.py exists and before any backtest result artifact.
